name: Steadfastness
overview: Steadfastness in Scripture is exemplified by Caleb, who followed God fully with a different spirit, demonstrating unwavering commitment (Numbers 14:24). God’s unchanging faithfulness assures believers that His promises will be fulfilled without fail (Numbers 23:19). The call to cleave to God and serve Him wholeheartedly is a clear command, underscoring the necessity of steadfast devotion (Deuteronomy 10:20; Joshua 24:15). Even in the face of severe trials, as with Job, steadfastness is marked by holding fast to integrity and faithfulness without turning aside (2 Kings 22:2; Job 2:3).
